categories.details: 元件太近会导致贴装碰撞，不同大小的元件对安全间距有不同要求，本检测项是根据元件大小来检测元件碰撞安全风险，尺寸越大要求的间距越大。检测方式是元件按比例放大进行碰撞，结果值就是放大比例，比如：0.06表示放大 6% 后，两元件就碰撞了。

details.en: Components placed too close can collide during assembly. Different sized components require different clearances, with larger sizes needing more spacing. Collision detection inflates components and reports the scale factor when collision occurs, e.g. 0.06 means 6% inflation caused a collision.
